final_text: The General Fund revised budget for FY2025 was $10.20bn, against an adopted budget of $9.38bn. Committed spend was $9.57bn, a utilisation of 93.9%, leaving $626.6m unspent. Departments with the lowest utilisation: Non-Departmental - Unappropriated Balance used 0.0% of a $96.8m budget; Non-Departmental - General City Purposes used 55.4% of a $306.4m budget; Council used 76.0% of a $72.3m budget.
